explanation: Asks whether for every order k > 0 there are infinitely many balanced primes of order k (p_n equals the mean of the k primes on each side; k ≤ n avoids negative indices). The definition matches Wikipedia's "Generalization" section. However, Wikipedia only conjectures infinitude for ordinary (order-1) balanced primes. It does not state a conjecture for higher orders; it just lists OEIS A082077–A082079. So this statement extrapolates beyond the cited source, and the docstring should cite a source for it or mark it as a natural generalization.
